title: Quantifiers advanced
note: few / a few against little / a little · most, all, none, some, several with and without `of` · both / neither / either and their verb agreement · each against every, plus no and any · 4 strands x 12 · 48 items · built to live 2026-08-07 (cloud run 9)

items.explanation: few / a few go with countable plural nouns, little / a little with uncountable nouns. Without `a` the meaning is negative — almost none.

cards.title: The `a` changes the meaning
cards.body: few and little on their own mean almost none — the speaker is complaining. a few and a little mean some — the speaker is satisfied. Same words, opposite attitude.
cards.body_cz: Samotné few a little znamenají skoro žádný — mluvčí si stěžuje. a few a a little znamenají nějaký — mluvčí je spokojený. Stejná slova, opačný postoj.

rows: We have a few seats left.

cards.title: `of` only before the / my / this / us
cards.title_cz: `of` jen před the / my / this / us
cards.body: A quantifier before a bare noun takes no `of`. Add `of` only when a determiner or pronoun follows.
cards.body_cz: Kvantifikátor před holým podstatným jménem `of` nemá. `of` se přidá, jen když následuje určovatel nebo zájmeno.
points: Most people work. — Most of the students passed.
All cars need petrol. — All of my keys are in the bag.
Some people never complain. — Some of my colleagues work at home.
none always takes of: None of the options is ideal.
Never `the most of` — that is a direct copy of `většina z`

cards.title: both / neither / either: exactly two
cards.body: These three are only for two things. For more than two, use all, none and any.
cards.body_cz: Tato tři slova platí jen pro dvě věci. Pro víc než dvě se používá all, none a any.
points: both = the two together, plural verb: Both cars are broken.
neither = not one of the two, singular verb: Neither option is ideal.
either = one of the two, no matter which: Either day is fine.
with of: both of my parents · neither of the shops · either of these seats
neither already means not — never `neither of them don't work`

cards.title: each and every, no and any
cards.title_cz: each a every, no a any
cards.body: each looks at the members one by one, every looks at the whole group. Both are followed by a singular noun and a singular verb.
cards.body_cz: each se dívá na jednotlivce po jednom, every na celou skupinu. Po obou následuje jméno i sloveso v jednotném čísle.
points: Each of the rooms has a window. — Every room has a window.
each of + the/my/us · every one of + the/my/us (never `every of`)
no + noun: There are no seats left.
any = it does not matter which: Take any bag you like.
